description: This file defines a utility class 'WidgetDataResourceWorker' which manages dynamic loading of a 'DataResourceWorkerInterface' implementation for widget content resources. It includes static initialization and a getter method for accessing the dynamically loaded object.

classes.name: WidgetDataResourceWorker
classes.description: A final utility class responsible for dynamically loading and providing access to a DataResourceWorkerInterface implementation.

methods.name: getDataresourceWorker
methods.description: Returns the instance of DataResourceWorkerInterface, which is loaded dynamically during class initialization.
